data.name: Aabroo
data.gender_notes: Aabroo is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root letters ء أ A A, meaning 'to delight', 'to please', or 'to be a source of joy'. The name Aabroo carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Aabroo usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the joy and happiness that comes from following the path of God and living a righteous life.
data.etymology: Aabroo belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Pleasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabroo total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أَبْرُؤُ
in_arabic.meaning: أَبْرُؤُ هو اسم علم يُشير إلى الأمان والسلامة
in_arabic.long_meaning: أَبْرُؤُ هو اسم علم يُشير إلى الأمان والسلامة والحرية من الأخطار، ويتكون من حرف الألف والباء والراء والواو والقاف، ويُعتبر من الأسماء السابقة في الإسلام، حيث ظهرت في القرآن الكريم في سورة المجادلة، آیة 11، حيث يقول الله تعالى: ﴿لَا يُؤَخَّرُ الدَّهْرُ مَن كُنتُمْ تَمُتُونَ مَرَّةً وَتُحْيَوْنَ مَرَّةً﴾، ويعتبر أبرو من أسماء الله الحسنى، حيث يُستخدم في التفسير والحديث، ويُعتبر من الأسماء التي يُفضلها المسلمون، ويُعتقد أن أبرو يعني الأمان والسلامة، حيث يُشير إلى الحالة التي يجد فيها الإنسان السلامة والحرية من الأخطار.

in_english.name: Aabroo
in_english.meaning: Aabroo is a name that means safety and security
in_english.long_meaning: Aabroo is a name that means safety and security, derived from the Arabic root 'abr' which means safety and protection, the name Aabroo is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Mujadalah, verse 11, which says 'لا يؤخر الدهر من كنتم تموتون مرة وحيون مرة' meaning 'the time will not be delayed for those who die and are resurrected', Aabroo is considered one of the beautiful names of Allah, it is used in tafsir and hadith, and is considered a preferred name among Muslims, it is believed to mean safety and security, as it refers to the state of being safe and secure from harm.
